About

About the Webmaster

Hi! My name is Fire. I'm 19. My birthday's April 30th! I'm (half-)Filipino-American.

My main interests are vocal synthesis, video games, and linguistics. In my free time, I like to draw, write, play games, listen to music, scroll social media, and use my computer.

My native language is English. I can speak some Japanese, and bits and pieces of Chinese. I can read Hangeul, but I don't really know Korean. In the future, I want to be a linguistics major and translator of Japanese.

Also check out my answers to 100 webmaster questions.

About the Website

I made this website as a space away from social media. As a bonus, it will be the (eventual) hosting site of my UTAU. BTW: the picture on the left (not visible on mobile) is a drawing I did of my UTAU.

I don't use generative AI and everything on my site was either created by me or sourced from humans.

My website is "licensed" under CC0.

Accessibility

As a disabled person myself, I take accessibility very seriously*. So, I made this website with accessibility in mind.

  • Works on any resolution and mobile
  • Legible text at 200% zoom (and beyond)
  • No autoplaying audio, videos, GIFs, etc.
  • Semantic HTML whenever possible
  • All images (well, I only have one image) have alt text
  • Navigable using the [tab] and arrow keys
  • Language text set to "en" on all pages
  • Colors tested for contrast

In general, I'm a very big advocate of accessibility in web design. I don't like how a lot of personal websites seem to neglect accessibility, mobile compatibility, etc. in favor of "aesthetic" when in reality their website is very ugly. To me, the prettiest websites are accessible!

If there are any accessibility improvements I could do for this website, please let me know.

*read: I'm autistic about accessible web design
